title: DevExp FieldKit Handoff Standup - Nov 16 2026
body:
Attendees: Aisha (owner), Tomás, Liam, Maya, Evan, plus drop-ins from Solutions Eng (Nadia)
Meeting length: 35m (quick sync)

Purpose: rapid alignment for FieldKit handoff (compact quickstart bundle for pilot customers), confirm canary plan, and list critical fixes before handoff to Solutions Eng on Nov 23. Focus areas: SDK integration, sample app stability, docs copy + troubleshooting checklist, telemetry/metrics for pilot.

1) Quick status round-robin
- SDKs (Tomás): python SDK 1.14.0 candidate built. Key changes: streaming interface fix for partial-chunks on socket disconnect; added 'retryable' error metadata to generation responses so quickstarts can show structured guidance. Running internal smoke tests against hosted-api and dedicated stubs. Failing case: intermittent tokenization mismatch on quantized model path when using 8-bit adapter. Root cause suspected in tokenizer version mismatch across wheel and wheel + wheel-ext.
- Samples (Liam): FieldKit sample app (React + Node) now includes interactive chat + embeddings search demo. Found a race where the sample's local cache invalidation can cause duplicate requests to the embed endpoint under quick nav. Reproduced in Chrome and Safari. Patch ready (branch: fix/cache-debounce-fieldkit).
- Quickstarts & Docs (Maya): Draft quickstart guide written, but missing troubleshooting section and runbook. Need short checklist for network / CORS and token scoping when customers use Dedicated vs Hosted. Working on copy that explains canary toggle and model pinning for customers.
- Observability / Telemetry (Evan): Instrumentation added to sample to emit 'sample-run' events to analytics pipeline (non-PII). Will capture latency p50/p95, token counts, and error classes. Need final event schema signed off by Privacy for pilot.

2) Blockers and risks (prioritized)
- Tokenizer mismatch (high): blocking python quickstart running on quantized path. Action: Tomás to pin tokenizer versions in SDK wheel and publish patch release by EOD Nov 18. Jira RI-4599.
- Cache double-request bug (medium): causes spikes in request count during onboarding demo. Action: Liam to merge fix and bump sample version; target Nov 17 deploy to staging.
- Docs missing runbook (medium): solutions eng needs runbook to handle customer pre-flight checks. Action: Maya to draft 1-page troubleshooting checklist + one-pager 'When to escalate to Redwood SRE' by Nov 18.
- Telemetry schema approval (low): Privacy review queued. Action: Evan to follow up and gate event publish until approved; will provide sample payloads in Confluence.

3) Canary plan (Nov 18–23)
- Goal: run FieldKit with 5 pilot accounts (internal + 2 external) to validate SDK behavior and onboarding docs.
- Steps:
  a) Nov 18: SDK patch released (Tomás) + sample image built (Liam)
  b) Nov 19: Smoke run: internal pilot (eng-only) — confirm no tokenization errors, verify telemetry events
  c) Nov 20: Invite 2 external pilot users from Solutions Eng list; provide one-click quickstart instructions and notorious edge-case checklist
  d) Nov 21–22: Collect feedback, patch quickstart and sample as needed
  e) Nov 23: Handoff meeting with Solutions Eng + Customer Success. If all blockers resolved, mark as released to pilot status.

4) Action items (owner / due)
- Tomás: Publish python SDK patch (1.14.1) with tokenizer pin + integration test; due 2026-11-18. Linked to RI-4599.
- Liam: Merge fix/cache-debounce-fieldkit, build sample image, and push demo to staging; due 2026-11-17.
- Maya: Complete troubleshooting checklist (1pager) + update quickstart with canary steps; due 2026-11-18.
- Evan: Share telemetry event spec and sample payloads; follow up with Privacy; due 2026-11-18.
- Aisha: Coordinate Solutions Eng invites and prepare Handoff slide (one slide: scope, canary outcomes, known issues) due 2026-11-20.

5) Notes-to-self / rough ideas (informal)
- Consider adding a lightweight 'local-only' mock server in quickstart to let customers run demos offline if they can't reach a region. Could reduce onboarding friction for regulated pilots.
- Add a troubleshooting snippet in SDK: "how to detect tokenization mismatch" (small script to compare tokenizer outputs across versions). Might be useful to surface as an automated preflight check in the quickstart.
- Estimate: if we get through current blockers, pilot-ready is ~5 engineering-days of focused work across team.

6) Open questions
- Does Dedicated require a separate token prefix in quickstart examples? (Maya) -> Action: Product to confirm by Nov 17 (Aisha to ping product-hosted-api).
- Should we expose telemetry events in the sample UI for customers? Risk: PII exposure, but helpful for debugging. (Evan) -> Privacy will advise; default UX should hide raw events but present basic metrics.

7) Follow-ups / meeting cadence
- Daily short check-ins (15m) Nov 17–19 to move blockers; standup time 10:00 PST.
- Full sync Nov 20 for smoke-run recap.

Appendix (quick links & logs)
- Staging demo URL: https://staging-fieldkit.redwood.ai (internal only)
- Branches: fix/cache-debounce-fieldkit, sdk/tokenizer-pin-1.14.1
- Local repro notes (Liam): reproduce steps for cache bug: 1) open sample, 2) perform 3 quick searches, 3) verify duplicate embed requests in network tab -> occurs when cache invalidation not debounced
- Test matrix (Tomás): run python tests against hosted-emulator, dedicated-mock, and quantized-runner. Add quantized-runner to CI matrix post-patch.

End of notes.

Status: saving as in_review — will update to final after canary complete and Solutions Eng signoff.
